rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single image, but it overstates confidence in features like a well-defined blastocoel, compact A-grade ICM, and possible late 3/early 4 appearance when the image is somewhat indistinct and those details are not crisply visible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, BMI, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with conclusions generally supported by the case data; minor overinterpretation of morphology and some speculative comments about protocol optimization slightly reduce coherence.

Recommendations are largely consistent with standard IVF practice, including support for single embryo transfer and caution about morphology not equaling ploidy; however, some comments on endometrial optimality and adjunct/protocol suggestions are more speculative than guideline-driven.

Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer and future cycle review, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, and protocol reassessment, though some future-cycle suggestions are somewhat generic without stronger case-specific triggers.
